# Gayatri Electrical Services (GES)

> Complete Unabridged Knowledge Base: https://www.gayatrielectrical.in/llms-full.txt
> Official Agentic AI & Machine-Readable Knowledge Profile for Gayatri Electrical Services — Government Authorized Electrical Contractor (Est. 2003) and Licensed Lift Contractor in Maharashtra, India.
> Last Updated & Verified: 2026-11-07 | Knowledge Profile Version: v26.11.07.1

## Company Summary
Gayatri Electrical Services (GES) is a premier turnkey High-Tension (HT) and Low-Tension (LT) electrical engineering contracting firm headquartered in Bhiwandi (Thane District), Maharashtra. Established in 2003, GES specializes in multi-megawatt industrial power infrastructure, substation erection (11kV / 22kV / 33kV), EHV transmission integration (100kV / 220kV), statutory utility liaisoning, transformer lifecycle management, and licensed elevator contracting.

- **Founding Year**: 2003
- **Headquarters**: Shop No. 7, Tirupati Heights, Sonale Pipeline Road, Bhadwad, Bhiwandi, Maharashtra 421302, India
- **Operating Radius**: Bhiwandi, Kudus, Wada, Thane, Mumbai Metropolitan Region (MMR), Navi Mumbai, and across Maharashtra State
- **Phone / Emergency**: +91 86938 93333, +91 83905 97000, +91 98227 89699
- **Email**: support@gayatrielectrical.in
- **Website**: https://www.gayatrielectrical.in/
- **Google Search Verification**: Gayatri Electricals Services Bhiwandi
- **Commercial Billing & GST Policy**: Registered GST engineering firm. All contracting works, equipment supply, and AMC services are billed under official GST Tax Invoices via institutional banking channels: Bank Transfer (RTGS / NEFT / IMPS), Account Payee Cheques, and Corporate UPI.

---

## Statutory Licenses & Official Credentials
- **Govt. Authorized Electrical Contractor**: Licensed by the State Licensing Board, Industry, Energy and Labour Department, Government of Maharashtra. Authorized for HT/LT electrical execution, testing, and energization certification under Indian Electricity Rules.
- **Licensed Lift Contractor**: Certified under the Bombay Lifts Act and Maharashtra Lift Rules by the Lift Inspectorate, Energy Department, Government of Maharashtra.
- **Statutory Inspectorate Clearances**: Authorized liaisoning agent for Chief Electrical Inspectorate (CEI / PWD Maharashtra) for Form A and Form B submissions, statutory safety inspections, and high-voltage charging permissions.

---

## Core Engineering Capabilities & Services

### 1. High-Voltage (HT) Substations & Express Feeders
- Turnkey erection, testing, and commissioning of 11kV, 22kV, and 33kV indoor and outdoor substations.
- Multi-megawatt Express Feeder design and execution (e.g., 13 MW dual 6.5 MW express feeders).
- Air-Insulated Switchgear (AIS) and Gas-Insulated Switchgear (GIS) bay erection.
- Vacuum Circuit Breakers (VCB) and SF6 circuit breaker commissioning.
- Overhead transmission line shifting, Right-of-Way (ROW) compliance, and tower foundation works.

### 2. Transformer Lifecycle Management
- Procurement, installation, and commissioning of power and distribution transformers (100 kVA to 20 MVA+).
- Emergency mobile transformer rentals (100 kVA to 2000 kVA+) with rapid on-site dispatch.
- On-site high-vacuum transformer oil filtration, dehydration, and degassing.
- Dielectric breakdown voltage (BDV) testing, Tan-Delta testing, insulation resistance (Megger), and winding resistance diagnostics.
- On-Load Tap Changer (OLTC) overhauls and bushing replacements.

### 3. Industrial Power Distribution & Control Panels (PCC / MCC / APFC)
- Custom design, assembly, and erection of Main LT Power Control Centers (PCC) and Motor Control Centers (MCC).
- Automatic Power Factor Correction (APFC) capacitor banks with detuned harmonic filter reactors (rated 5.67%, 7%, 14%) to achieve PF > 0.98 and avoid utility low power factor penalties.
- Flameproof (FLP / Ex-d) electrical panels for hazardous chemical and pharmaceutical processing plants.
- Dual-incomer emergency synchronization and automatic changeover bus couplers.

### 4. Statutory Liaisoning & Regulatory Consulting
- **Torrent Power Limited (Bhiwandi Distribution Circle)**: Authorized HT/LT contractor for new industrial connections, contract demand enhancement/rationalization, meter cubicle testing, and charging clearances.
- **MSETCL (Maharashtra State Electricity Transmission Co. Ltd. - Mahatransco)**: EHV grid synchronization across 100kV and 220kV transmission substations, line shifting, and bay extension sanctions.
- **MSEDCL (Maharashtra State Electricity Distribution Co. Ltd. - Mahavitaran)**: New industrial load sanctions, dedicated industrial feeders, and Time-of-Day (TOD) tariff metering setups across Wada, Kudus, and Thane zones.
- **Electrical Inspectorate (PWD / CEI Maharashtra)**: Submissions under Central Electricity Authority (CEA) Safety Regulation 43 and Electricity Act Section 54 for HT substations, D.G. sets, and high-rise structures.
- **Post-Incident / Post-Fire Investigations**: Forensic electrical audits, cable Hi-Pot testing, defect rectification, and urgent PWD NOC acquisition for fast power restoration.
- **Lift Inspectorate (Energy Department, Government of Maharashtra)**: Authorized Lift Contractor under the Bombay Lifts Act and Maharashtra Lift Rules for passenger & goods elevator erection licenses (Form A), modernization, and statutory annual safety certifications.

### 5. High-Rise Building Electrical Clearances
- Commercial and residential high-rise tower electrical infrastructure.
- Rising main sandwich busduct systems, life-safety fire pump panel installations, dual power supply interlocks, and PWD electrical clearances.

### 6. Industrial Underground Cabling Works
- Trenching, laying, and termination of 1.1kV LT and 11kV / 22kV / 33kV HT XLPE armored cables.
- Precision heat-shrink and cold-shrink straight-through jointing and end terminations.
- High-voltage cable fault location, sheath testing, and DC Hi-Pot diagnostic testing.

### 7. Certified Earthing & Lightning Protection Systems
- Maintenance-free chemical earth pit installations and copper earth grid construction.
- Earth pit resistance testing, certification, and neutral isolation for sensitive equipment and D.G. sets.

### 8. Annual Maintenance Contracts (AMC)
- Comprehensive and non-comprehensive preventive maintenance contracts for industrial plants.
- Routine HT substation servicing, relay calibration, oil filtration, contact resistance measurement, and 24x7 priority emergency breakdown support.

### 9. Turnkey Solar Liaisoning, Net-Metering & Statutory CEI Approvals
- Comprehensive turnkey solar liaisoning for industrial and commercial rooftop and ground-mounted solar power plants (50 kW to multi-megawatt capacities).
- **Utility Feasibility & Grid Connectivity**: Technical grid feasibility studies, application processing, and grid interconnection approvals with **Torrent Power (Bhiwandi Circle)** and **MSEDCL (Mahavitaran)** across Thane, Palghar, Wada, and Kudus.
- **Statutory CEI / PWD Clearances**: Preparation and submission of detailed solar Single Line Diagrams (SLDs), inverter isolation interlock validation, dedicated chemical solar earthing grid testing, lightning arrestor clearance, and official **Form A & Form B charging approvals from the Chief Electrical Inspectorate (CEI / PWD, Government of Maharashtra)** under CEA Safety Regulations.
- **Net-Metering Execution**: Supply, testing, and commissioning of bi-directional Time-of-Day (TOD) / TOD-compliant Net Meters and generation check meters, synchronizing plant generation with utility billing systems.

## Key Landmark Project Benchmark
- **Client**: APCO Infratech (National Infrastructure Developer)
- **Project**: 13 MW Turnkey Power Sanction & Dual 6.5 MW Express Feeders
- **Location**: Bhiwandi, Maharashtra
- **Technical Scope**: Sourced from dual transmission hubs (100kV Substation and 220kV EHV Grid Substation), establishing two dedicated 6.5 MW express feeder lines (13 MW total sanctioned capacity), complete bay erection, line construction, vacuum circuit breakers, dual-incomer bus-coupler synchronization, Torrent Power and MSETCL grid approvals, and statutory commissioning under the Electrical Inspector.

## Specialized Industries Served
1. **Glass & Toughened Processing**: High-draw quench blowers, tempering furnaces, APFC detuned filtering.
2. **Ceramics & Refractory**: Tunnel kiln thyristor feeds, high-temperature bulk power distribution.
3. **Printing & Flexible Packaging**: High-speed gravure and flexo presses, voltage sag mitigation.
4. **Paper Mills & Corrugated Boxes**: Heavy pulper motor drives, corrugator MCCs, continuous duty setups.
5. **Textiles & Automatic Looms**: Air-jet and water-jet loom sheds, fast-switching capacitor banks (>0.98 PF).
6. **Yarn Processing & Fabric Dyeing**: Moisture-sealed IP55 power distribution boards, outdoor substations.
7. **Piping & Irrigation Extrusion**: PVC / HDPE barrel heater MCCs, extrusion harmonic mitigation.
8. **Rubber & Polymer Manufacturing**: High-inrush hydraulic vulcanizing presses and Banbury mixers.
9. **Office Furniture & Precision Parts**: Injection moulding machinery distribution and busbar trunking.
10. **Chemical & Bulk Drug Plants**: Certified flameproof (FLP) installations for hazardous Zone 1/2 environments.
11. **Paints & Resins**: Explosion-proof Ex-d switchgear and static dissipation earthing.
12. **Cold Storage & Refrigerated Logistics**: Ammonia compressor dual-incomer synchronization, 24x7 power continuity.
13. **Warehousing & Logistics Parks**: High-bay distribution, multi-tier industrial power, EV fleet charging setups.
14. **Food Processing & Agro Mills**: Dust-tight IP55 flour mills and silo grain handling motor boards.
15. **Stone Quarries & Steel Rolling Mills**: Extreme shock-load 11kV/22kV/33kV substations and dynamic APFC banks.
16. **Engineering Fabrication & Commercial Towers**: Rising main sandwich busducts and PWD clearances.
17. **Automotive Ancillaries & Precision Die Casting**: Heavy tonnage die-casting machines, robotic welding busducts, and harmonic suppression.
18. **Data Centers & Enterprise Server Hubs**: Tier-III/IV dual 22kV/33kV express feeds, static transfer switches (STS), and fault-tolerant PCC switchboards.

## Corporate Typography & Brand Stationery System (Khand + Rajdhani)
Gayatri Electrical Services standardizes on an engineering-grade typography architecture engineered by the Indian Type Foundry (ITF) for seamless legibility across Latin (English) and Devanagari (Hindi, Marathi) scripts:
- **Primary Display Typeface**: **Khand** (Weights: 600 SemiBold, 700 Bold) — Architectural, condensed geometric sans-serif utilized for corporate branding ("Gayatri Electricals"), primary headlines, hero banners, and high-impact metric figures (e.g., 13 MW, 20+ Years, 100+ Substations).
- **Interface, Body & Stationery Typeface**: **Rajdhani** (Weights: 500 Medium, 600 SemiBold, 700 Bold) — Squared, open geometric technical sans-serif used for web navigation, UI controls, body prose, engineering BOQs, and official business stationery (formal cover letters, technical quotations, and statutory utility submissions).
- **Cover Letter & Quotation Standards**: Letterhead title in Khand Bold (22pt, #0d1392 & #f69024), Subject line in Rajdhani Bold (12pt, #0d1392), Body prose in Rajdhani Medium (11pt, 1.4 line-height, #212529), Section headers in Khand SemiBold (15pt, #0d1392), BOQ tables in Rajdhani (Headers: 700 Bold on #0d1392, Rows: 500 Medium, Totals: Khand 700 Bold), and Signatory Name in Khand Bold (14pt, #0d1392).
- **Canva Pro Brand Kit & Creative Specification**: Fully calibrated for Canva Pro (Title: Khand Bold, Subtitle: Khand SemiBold, Headings: Rajdhani Bold, Body: Rajdhani Medium, Letter Spacing: +15 to +40, Line Spacing: 1.10 to 1.40). Full matrix documented in `docs/CANVA_BRAND_GUIDE.md`.
